coverage.summary: Applies only to housing providers that receive DND funding or land, or that have income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy. It is also applied to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity Affirmative Marketing Program. It is not a citywide rule for all landlords.
coverage.owner_conditions: Housing provider receives DND funding and/or land, or has income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.
coverage.other_conditions: Federal or state law imposing a conflicting criminal-history requirement preempts the policy.

result.notes: Coverage is defined by the provider's funding or land source, or by inclusionary-unit status, not by building size or age. Summary and owner_conditions are tied to the D010 applicability sentence. The preemption clause supports other_conditions and supersedes_state_rule=false. The 'not a citywide rule' statement in the summary is an inference drawn from that limited applicability. No unit-count, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits appear in the documents. D011 through D014 concern other Boston measures and do not bear on this policy's coverage.
